meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复各类运行时故障，从崩溃到内存泄漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常遭遇崩溃、泄漏或莫名失败却难以定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix any runtime failure, from crashes to memory leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face crashes, leaks, or unexplained failures and can't find the root cause.

howto.what: 遇到程序出问题时,Claude 会先查看程序实际运行状态,提出至少三个可能原因并并行排查;两轮无果会换角度重新分析。确认根因后用失败测试复现,做最小修复,再实际运行验证;最后会清理调试时创建的临时文件,这些操作都会记录在日志中。
howto.when: 适用于任何真实运行时调试:程序崩溃、卡死、静默失败等;当你要求调试、复现并修复问题,或需要逆向工程时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试一下:程序崩溃了,但不知道什么原因。
say.note: Claude 会先观察实际运行状态再开始排查。

say.text: 为什么这个接口返回 200 但内容是空的?
say.note: 他会从空响应入手追查静默失败的原因。

say.text: 这个测试偶尔失败,单独跑却通过。帮我查一下。
say.note: 他会按间歇性故障的方法先收窄排查范围。

howto.what_en: Claude inspects live runtime state, proposes ≥3 hypotheses, investigates in parallel, confirms the root cause, locks it with a failing test, applies a minimal fix, verifies by using the system, and cleans up journaled artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers for any real runtime debugging: crashes, hangs, silent failures, etc.; or when you ask Claude to debug, reproduce and fix, or reverse engineer.

say_en.text: Debug this for me: the program crashes but we don't know why.
say_en.note: Claude inspects runtime state and starts the hypothesis loop

say_en.text: Why does this API return HTTP 200 with an empty body?
say_en.note: If it's a silent failure, Claude will trace it.

say_en.text: This test fails intermittently but passes alone. Help me find why.
say_en.note: Claude treats it as flaky and narrows down the cause.
